tags.vehicle: Car, train, aircraft, boat, or machine in motion
tags.cityscape: Urban street, buildings, or exterior architecture
tags.interior: Indoor room, gallery, studio, or stage
tags.abstract: Non-figurative geometry, signal, or visual study
tags.text-content: Prominent typography, signage, or score notation
tags.pattern: Repeating ornament, grid, or algorithmic motif

tags.pair: Two people interacting or side by side

tags.upper-body: Waist or chest up medium/portrait shot
tags.closeup: Tight close-up on detail or body part
tags.arms-raised: Arms lifted or extended away from torso

tags.back: Rear view facing away from camera

tags.gesture: Expressive facial, hand, or upper-body gesture
tags.pose: Held or deliberate body posture / flexing
tags.fight: Wrestling, boxing, fencing, or martial arts
tags.sport: Athletic event, throwing, gymnastics, or track & field

tags.static-camera: Locked-off tripod camera with minimal global flow
tags.moving-camera: Panning, tracking, handheld, or moving camera
tags.cuts: Contains multiple shots or scene cuts

tags.high-contrast: Strong tonal separation between subject and background
tags.plain-bg: Clean, uniform, or gridded studio backdrop
tags.grain: Visible film grain, halftone, or analog surface texture

tags.silent: No audio track or silent-era film
tags.noise: Broadband noise, glitch, or industrial sound

tags.loop-friendly: Works cleanly when played in a continuous loop
tags.seamless: Seamless wraparound in time or space

tags.early-film: Early cinema (c. 1888–1915, Edison, Lumière, Marey, Demenÿ)
tags.chronophotography: Sequential motion-capture plates or strips (Muybridge, Marey)
tags.own-capture: Captured, scanned, or recorded by the author/course

tags.seamless-loop: First and last frames connect without a visible jump
tags.one-shot-anim: Single action that resets at the loop boundary
tags.cinemagraph: Mostly still image with isolated looping motion
tags.rotoscope: Traced or rotoscoped from live-action footage
tags.found-gif: Curated found GIF from web or film excerpt

tags.drawing: Ink, pencil, charcoal, or graphic drawing
tags.print: Lithograph, woodcut, etching, or printed poster
tags.diagram: Technical, musical, or analytical diagram / score
tags.sequence: Multi-frame contact sheet or chronophotographic plate
tags.panorama: Wide panoramic or Street View capture

tags.animated: Contains keyframe or skeletal animation clips
tags.prop: Single object, furniture, or artifact mesh
tags.textured: Has UV-mapped image textures or vertex colors

tags.outdoor: Exterior street, landscape, or architectural scene
tags.noisy: Contains floaters or unpruned peripheral splats

tags.plotter-ready: Clean paths suitable for pen plotters / CNC

tags.primitive: Basic geometric SDF (sphere, box, torus, cylinder)
tags.fractal: Iterated function system or fractal SDF (Mandelbulb, Menger)
tags.minimal-surface: Minimal surface with zero mean curvature (Gyroid, Enneper, Schwarz)
tags.implicit: Implicit algebraic or polynomial surface f(x,y,z)=0
tags.knot: Torus knot, trefoil knot, or mathematical link
tags.manifold: Topological manifold or non-orientable surface (Klein bottle, Mobius)
